🚀

Hi there! 👋 I'm **TingAI**, the official AI assistant for Ting-A-Ling Schools in Meerensee, Richards Bay.

I'm here to help with any questions about our Pre-Primary or Special Needs schools — fees, enrolment, hours, uniforms, or anything else. What can I help you with? 😊
Tell me more about out the schools

Of course! Ting-A-Ling Schools in Meerensee, Richards Bay, is made up of two schools under one management 🤖

**Pre-Primary School** — at 74 Krewilkring, for children aged 2 to 6 years. It's play-based with a focus on building confidence, creativity, and school readiness. Half-day options are available.

**Special Needs School** — at 18 Elweboog, for children aged 3 to 12 years. They offer individualised education with a dedicated team of specialists, therapy support, and a focus on independence, communication, and life skills.

Both schools operate from 07:00 to 13:00 on school days, with aftercare options available. If you'd like more info on a specific school — fees, enrolment, uniform, etc. — just let me know which one you're interested in!
Thats great how do I enroll my child?

Great question! 😊 Before I give you the details, could you let me know — are you looking to enrol at our **Pre-Primary School** (ages 2–6) or the **Special Needs School** (ages 3–12)? That way I can share the right information for you.

Our Special Needs School is located at 18 Elweboog, Meerensee, and caters for children aged 3 to 12 years with diverse learning needs. We offer individualised care, personalised learning programmes, therapy support, and a focus on independence, communication, and life skills in small class groups.

Our hours are 07:00–13:00 or 07:00–17:00 with aftercare, and fees range from R3,000 to R3,300 per month depending on the hours you need. Give the school office a call on 0615274429 or 0724561282 if you'd like to arrange a tour 🤖
